selection: Targeted primary-figure follow-up of three other exposed long-cycle leads.

candidates.sample_family: Yang sugarcane bagasse and beef bone powder co-derived carbon, BS series
candidates.secondary_lead: Local U010/main.txt cites 63.7% at 20,000 cycles. No author endpoint assigned from this secondary sentence.
candidates.figure_observation: Figs. 5(e) and 6(e) show four sample traces each through 20,000 cycles. Both plot absolute specific capacitance; the primary highlights separately identify the three-electrode 397.9 F/g rate test. The image alone does not identify which cycling panel, sample, baseline and current support the cited 63.7%.

Fig. 6(d) shows separated blue retention markers around the reported 82% at 5,000 cycles. Inset gives a potential/time profile but no legible configuration or current. Fig. 5 single-rate or rate sweep is separate.

candidates.sample_family: Tu nickel foam supported activated carbon solid-state symmetric supercapacitor
candidates.figure_observation: Fig. 6(i) gives 51.4% after 5,000 cycles at 5.0 mA/cm². Fig. 6(a) shows PVA/KOH. Biomass precursor of the activated carbon unverified. Retain as a separate areal, solid-state reference.
